# Calculate positions for the plates and cutout
# First plate (horizontal): 140x140x10 mm
# Second plate (vertical): 140x140x10 mm at 90° angle
# Cutout in first plate: 45x45 mm in center

# First plate dimensions and position
plate1_x_size = 140
plate1_y_size = 140
plate1_z_size = 10
plate1_x = 0  # Start at origin
plate1_y = 0
plate1_z = 0

# Second plate (vertical, perpendicular to first)
# It should share one edge with the first plate
plate2_x_size = 140
plate2_y_size = 10  # This becomes the thickness in the new orientation
plate2_z_size = 140  # Height of the vertical plate
plate2_x = 0  # Same x position
plate2_y = 0  # Starts at the same edge
plate2_z = 10  # Starts where the first plate ends (on top)

# Cutout in the center of first plate
cutout_size = 45
# Center of first plate is at (70, 70) from its base point
cutout_x = plate1_x + (plate1_x_size - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_y = plate1_y + (plate1_y_size - cutout_size) / 2
cutout_z = 0  # Same z as the plate base
cutout_x_size = cutout_size
cutout_y_size = cutout_size
cutout_z_size = plate1_z_size  # Goes through entire thickness

print(f"First plate (horizontal): Position ({plate1_x}, {plate1_y}, {plate1_z}), Size ({plate1_x_size}, {plate1_y_size}, {plate1_z_size})")
print(f"Second plate (vertical): Position ({plate2_x}, {plate2_y}, {plate2_z}), Size ({plate2_x_size}, {plate2_y_size}, {plate2_z_size})")
print(f"Cutout: Position ({cutout_x}, {cutout_y}, {cutout_z}), Size ({cutout_x_size}, {cutout_y_size}, {cutout_z_size})")
